catalog.title: Seiko Luxury
catalog.note: JDM luxury catalogue (特別高級腕時計, published by K. Hattori & Co.): Seiko Quartz V.F.A., Seiko Quartz, Grand Seiko, ultra-thin and special-selection dress watches, engraved and urushi-lacquer pocket watches, and precious-metal bracelet, ring and Bell-Fina / Queen Seiko Special ladies' pieces, shot on dark studio backgrounds. Each caption prints the line name, the model number (with jewels 石 for mechanical models), case material and list price in yen, with (上/下/左/右/中) giving the pictured position, then the crystal (cut sapphire, Clearlex, Hardlex, colour-cut Hardlex) and any stone dial in 〈〉. Refs follow the 1972 Seiko Luxury file: 38SQ-034, 6810-070, LM36-120, 17QSL A-630. Where the model is a four-digit number (2220, 2411, 6810) it is the movement and is stored as `caliber`; family codes (38SQ, 56GAW, LM36, 17QSL …) leave it blank. No CCCC-NNNN case refs, case-dial numbers or bracelet codes are printed; straps and bracelets are described in `notes`. Diamond counts and finishes come from the page text. Scan index 0 is the cover (an uncaptioned bangle photo, not a separate record); p1 and p52 are text pages, p55 the back cover.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders of all 56 scan pages (Oct 2026), one record per pictured watch in caption order, verified against full-resolution caption crops (the PDF has almost no text layer); the stock detector cannot separate these dark, overlapping studio shots, so every photo box was set by hand from grid overlays and checked on per-page check sheets and crop contact sheets.
